mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, take my temperature, and sit at the edge of the bed until the fogginess eases.
mara.intention: Assess how unwell I am before deciding what I can reasonably do today.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into lounge clothes, and leave the workout clothes and shoes alone.
mara.intention: Handle basic hygiene without spending energy on the usual workout.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea with lemon and honey, carry the mug to the kitchen island, and eat toast with a little butter.
mara.intention: Settle my stomach and get something gentle into me.

mara.activity: Carry the mug and plate to the sink, rinse them, and leave the kitchen orderly before returning to bed.
mara.intention: Do only the necessary tidying while I still have a little energy.

mara.activity: Rest in bed with the curtains partly open, keeping my phone nearby in case the studio needs an update.
mara.intention: Let my body settle instead of forcing a normal start.

mara.activity: Send a short message that I am ill, cancel today's site and studio commitments, and flag only the most urgent presentation question.
mara.intention: Protect the workday while making the change in plans clear.

mara.activity: Make the bed loosely, carry my phone and water to the living room, and lie down on the sectional with the lights soft.
mara.intention: Change rooms without turning the morning into a project.

mara.activity: Eat yogurt and a banana at the coffee table, taking small sips of water.
mara.intention: Have a low-effort snack and avoid letting the illness become worse through dehydration or hunger.

mara.activity: Sleep or doze on the sectional, leaving the phone face down on the coffee table.
mara.intention: Rest through the period when I would normally be deep into work.

mara.activity: Warm a simple portion of yesterday's meal, carry it with a water glass to the dining table, and eat slowly.
mara.intention: Use leftovers rather than cooking a proper lunch.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and glass back to the kitchen, rinse them, and put the leftovers away.
mara.intention: Keep the food safe and leave only a small amount of cleanup.

mara.activity: Rest in the living room with my feet up and listen to a quiet podcast without answering messages.
mara.intention: Have company without demanding concentration.

mara.activity: Make one careful pass through the presentation notes from the living room, writing only the decisions that can wait until I recover.
mara.intention: Keep a thread of control over work without attempting a full work session.

mara.activity: Close the laptop, carry it and the project folder to the office desk, then return to the sectional and sleep.
mara.intention: Stop before the illness turns a small task into a late-day crash.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea, add lemon and honey, and drink it at the kitchen island while taking any needed cold medicine according to the label.
mara.intention: Stay comfortable and hydrated through the afternoon.

mara.activity: Sit quietly in the living room, keeping the room calm and accepting help if Julian checks in before leaving for the restaurant.
mara.intention: Stay connected without asking either of us to perform normal routines.

mara.activity: Take a warm, brief shower, put on an evening sweater and lounge pants, and leave the towel in the bathroom to dry.
mara.intention: Feel clean and more comfortable before the evening settles in.

mara.activity: Make scrambled eggs and toast at the island, carrying the plate and water glass to the living room rather than setting a formal dinner.
mara.intention: Eat something warm with minimal effort and no ambitious cooking.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and glass back to the kitchen, wash them, and wipe the island once.
mara.intention: Do a contained cleanup and then stop for the day.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional with the lights low, keeping tissues and water within reach.
mara.intention: Let the evening be quiet while Julian is at the restaurant.

mara.activity: Check messages once, reply only if something is genuinely urgent, and leave the phone on the living room sideboard afterward.
mara.intention: Avoid work spiraling into the evening.

mara.activity: Make another small mug of ginger tea and carry it to the bedroom.
mara.intention: Prepare for sleep and keep fluids nearby.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and take the tea and water to the bed.
mara.intention: Finish the day gently and avoid a rushed bedtime.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed, then put my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand and set the phone beside them.
mara.intention: Give my mind a quiet landing before sleep.

mara.activity: Turn off the light, stay warm, and sleep.
mara.intention: Prioritize recovery over the usual late-evening routine.

julian.activity: Wake quietly, wash, brush my teeth, and get dressed in comfortable clothes. I move carefully around the bedroom so Mara can rest, then check on her briefly and bring her a water glass from the kitchen.
julian.intention: Start gently and assess whether Mara needs immediate practical help without hovering.

julian.activity: Make coffee and carry a mug to the kitchen island. I grind the beans, add milk, and eat a banana while looking over the Monday schedule. I keep the coffee quiet and simple rather than making a full breakfast.
julian.intention: Get myself fed and oriented before taking care of Mara and the workday.

julian.activity: Make a gentle tomato-and-carrot soup for Mara. I carry the stockpot, carrots, canned tomatoes, olive oil, ladle, and market herbs to the range, simmer everything slowly, taste it, and portion a bowl onto a wooden tray. I leave it covered on the kitchen island with water nearby.
julian.intention: Give Mara something warm and low-effort to eat while preserving her quiet.

julian.activity: Wash the cooking utensils, wipe the range and island, and check on Mara once more. I carry my restaurant notebook and pen to the office, keeping my phone with me in case she needs me.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen safe and establish a calm check-in rhythm before work.

julian.activity: Handle Monday menu planning, ordering, and staff administration from the office. I work through the restaurant notebook, receipts, and menu folder, then call the trusted restaurant manager to discuss service coverage and make sure I can leave if Mara needs me.
julian.intention: Complete the essential Monday work without improvising alone or losing contact with home.

julian.activity: Take a quiet lunch break and bring a small bowl of yogurt and a water glass to the office. I send Mara a brief message asking how she is, without starting a long conversation.
julian.intention: Eat enough to stay steady and check in without making Mara manage my concern.

julian.activity: Finish ordering and staff administration, review the next day's delivery notes, and leave the restaurant notebook and receipts together on the office desk. I call the manager once more to confirm the evening plan before shutting down.
julian.intention: Close the Monday paperwork cleanly so the evening service is less uncertain.

julian.activity: Return to the kitchen, make fresh tea for Mara, and carry it with another water glass to the bedroom. I sit nearby for a few minutes if she wants company, then check the soup and wash the mug before getting ready for work.
julian.intention: Offer care in small, useful ways while respecting Mara's low energy.

julian.activity: Get ready for the restaurant. I change into work trousers, a restaurant shirt, kitchen clogs, and chef jacket, take my backpack and thermos, and carry my keys from the piano's middle shelf. I tell Mara where I will be and leave my phone available.
julian.intention: Leave prepared and make the plan clear so Mara does not have to guess when I will return.

julian.activity: Work restaurant prep and dinner service. I organize the line, taste sauces, and keep the service moving while the manager handles any urgent calls from home.
julian.intention: Do the essential service steadily while staying reachable for Mara.

julian.activity: Return home, put my keys on the piano's middle shelf, set my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and bring the thermos to the kitchen beside the sink. I check quietly that Mara is settled without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Shift out of service mode and make a brief, calm check-in.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, dry off, and change into sleep clothes. I leave the towel in the bathroom to dry and keep the lights low.
julian.intention: Release the physical tension of service before bed.

julian.activity: Eat a small serving of yogurt and drink water from the refrigerator rather than cooking again. I rinse the bowl and glass and leave them beside the sink.
julian.intention: Have something small without creating another task or waking Mara with kitchen noise.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, carry my phone to the main bedroom nightstand, and get into bed beside Mara without turning on the television. I keep the phone charging and settle quietly.
julian.intention: Rest while remaining available if Mara needs me during the night.
